trigger: real production startup showed two Data workers polling the same sources; one Kraken poll rate_limited
implementation: dedicated short-lived PostgreSQL connection owns a session advisory lock for the bounded polling round; other workers skip concurrent polls; source transactions continue to use the separate pool

automatic_tests.concurrency: contending worker skips without fetching; a later worker acquires after owner connection closes
automatic_tests.cancellation: cancelled collection closes owning connection; next worker can poll
